source_row.rationale: Ensuring the call light is within easy reach supports the client's ability to promptly summon assistance when needed, which can help reduce unassisted attempts to get up (a common contributing factor to falls) and supports the client's overall sense of security and ability to have their needs met in a timely manner — a basic but important safety and comfort practice for all hospitalized clients.
source_row.source_name: Standard Nursing Fundamentals — Call Light Accessibility and Patient Safety
